claims.evidence: No photo shows sensor resolution; missing shot of camera info menu or box specifications.
No photo or video shows shooting speed; missing clip of continuous shooting or spec sheet.
No photo shows the AF system; missing shot of AF specifications or focus-point display.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or functions are faulty
risks.proof: Video of the camera turning on, navigating menus, and taking a picture.

risks.risk: Shutter count is high or unknown
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from the camera menu or software.

risks.risk: Sensor has spots, scratches, or damage
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor at a small aperture or a clean-sensor check video.

risks.risk: Lens autofocus or optics are faulty, including fungus, scratches, or haze
risks.proof: Video of the lens focusing plus close-ups of front and rear glass and sample photos.
Photo of the battery and charger together.

risks.risk: No warranty or proof of purchase
risks.proof: Photo of the warranty card or original receipt.
risks.if_unproven: as out of warranty with no proof of age.

risks.risk: Undisclosed age, heavy usage, or repairs
risks.proof: Original receipt or clear photos of the body for dents, repair marks, or wear.

proof_requests: Photo showing the Nikon model number on the camera body and box
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo
Close-up photos of the lens glass, mount, and contacts
Screenshot of shutter count if the camera menu can display it
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nikon DSLR with lens but cannot read the model, and the model sets the market price; the seller's spec claims are unverified and cannot identify it.
